2.2.1.2-f23.accuracy_reason: As printed, both halves do say 'old age in youth'. Cicero, Cato Maior 38 approves of a young man with something old about him and an old man with something young.

2.2.1.2-f9.accuracy_reason: In Pro Marcello 8 Cicero praises the man who masters his anger and his victory; that man is Caesar. Burton applies the words to temperance.
